name: design-critic
description: A Claude Code skill that screenshots your website and gives an honest, prioritized design critique, then verifies the fixes before and after.

plugins.name: design-critic
plugins.description: Opens your site in a real browser, screenshots it on mobile, tablet and desktop, measures contrast, overflow, tap targets and motion, and delivers a prioritized HTML report with a fix for each problem. Verifies fixes before/after. 16 languages.
